name: BACH_0131
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (88%)** · Confident · Careful review

Single-class set and MUSK agree, but four of five similar cases are InSitu.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 88%, InSitu 11% | Clear lead |
| Conformal set | Benign only (90%) | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 1.00 / 94th percentile | Not flagged as suspect |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 1 of 5 Benign | Neighbors disagree |

## Tissue evidence
- **Scarce benign stroma/fat** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Low score; concept model links low values to invasion [F3] · Validated
- **Tumor-infiltrating stroma** (region 6) · ↓ invasive · Low score argues against stromal invasion [F4] · Validated
- **Neoplastic nuclei fraction** (regions 2, 3, 6) · context · 91% of sampled nuclei; top of reference set [F7] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Deletion test +0.54 logit versus random (CI 0.47–0.60) excludes 0, so it is faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI (−0.005 to 0.007) includes 0, so unproven; "normal lobules" (0/20 spot check) is Unreliable and leads this case.

## Could be wrong if
- InSitu (11%) is underweighted: four of five similar cases are InSitu.
- Cell measures cover only three regions, so they may not represent the whole image.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 2, 6**: per-region invasive risk 50% and 43%; look for stromal invasion.
2. **Regions 2, 3, 6**: 91% neoplastic nuclei; check whether they are duct-confined.
3. **Region 11**: low benign stroma/fat with gland formation; confirm benign architecture.
